node.script.csharp-source.name: C# continuous listener (.NET 10)
node.script.csharp-source.description: Emit a typed value and signal for each yield return from IAsyncEnumerable<T>. An optional CancellationToken ends waits when the workflow stops.
node.script.csharp.name: C# script (.NET 10)
node.script.csharp.description: Run public static Run(...) with typed JSON arguments and a typed result. The dedicated analyzer checks the current code before saving and executing.
node.script.python.name: Python script
node.script.python.description: Run def run(...) on the selected peer. Choose individual or named JSON inputs. Infer types from hints and simple expressions; unknown types accept any JSON value.
setting.pythonPath: Python executable on the execution peer (absolute path)
node.value.comment.name: Comment
node.value.comment.description: Pass the value and its type through unchanged. Name the output or leave the name empty to inherit the source port name. Comments are entered here only.
node.value.code.name: Code block
node.value.code.description: Edit highlighted code or configuration text and output the original string, including line breaks. C#, Python and JavaScript support syntax checks after typing pauses and on blur. This node never executes code.
Script return types are inferred from co: Script return types are inferred from code. Unconfirmed types are shown as any.
